rot.ideia.ex1.e1: To talk about chess, every square needs a name. That is what we will learn now.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The files run from bottom to top. Each has a letter, from a to h, from left to right.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: The rook is on the a-file, the first on the left.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Move the rook to the right, to the e-file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! a, b, c, d, e: the fifth file.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook moves right to the e-file: a, b, c, d, e.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: The rook did not stop on the e-file. Let's go back: count the letters starting from a.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Move the rook to the right, to the e-file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The letters are written along the bottom edge of the board. Use them to check.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember the idea: the file is the letter, counted from left to right.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The ranks run from side to side. Each has a number, from 1 to 8, from bottom to top.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The rook is on rank 1, the bottom one, on the e-file. The name of its square is e1.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: First the letter of the file, then the number of the rank.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Take the rook to rank 6, staying on its file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The rook is on e6: e-file, rank 6.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The rook goes up the e-file to rank 6. The square is called e6.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: The rook stopped on another rank. Let's go back: count the numbers from the bottom.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Take the rook to rank 6, staying on its file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The numbers are written along the left edge of the board.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Remember the idea: the name of a square is the letter of the file and the number of the rank, like e6.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show three things that help you find the squares.
rot.demos.cantos.e1: The a1 square is in the bottom left corner, and it is dark.
rot.demos.cantos.l1: On the other side, h8 is in the top right corner. Both are dark.
rot.demos.cantos.l2: The bottom right corner, h1, is light. That is true of every board.
rot.demos.pretas.e1: When you play Black, the board turns around: Black is at the bottom.
rot.demos.pretas.l1: Now a1 is top right, and the letters on the edge run from h to a. The names do not change.
rot.demos.pretas.l2: That is why you should always check the letters and numbers on the edge.
rot.demos.centro.e1: The four middle squares, d4, e4, d5 and e5, make up the centre of the board.
rot.demos.centro.l1: They come up a lot in games. It is worth finding them without counting.
rot.demos.centro.l2: Now it's your turn: in the next positions, I say the square and you click on it.
rot.pratica.achar.enunciado: Click on each square I ask for. First find the letter, then the number.
rot.pratica.achar.fim: Perfect. You can already read the board.
rot.pratica.comPretas.enunciado: Now with Black at the bottom. The names do not change: check the edge.
rot.pratica.comPretas.fim: Well done. From either side, a square has the same name.
rot.pratica.semCoordenadas.enunciado: Now without the edge. Count from a1, bottom left: letters to the right, numbers upwards.
rot.pratica.semCoordenadas.fim: With no help at all. From now on, you know where every square I mention is.
